Of 522 mosquitoes collected from our experimental huts, there were 383 successful DNA amplifications in PCR assays for both the kdr detection and species identification. All of these were determined to be An. arabiensis and all were kdr-negative (100%).

Finally, 43 mosquitoes collected directly from local houses in the study area, using CDC light traps set near occupied bed nets were analysed. In this case there were only 15 successful DNA amplifications in the PCR for both kdr detection and species identification, all of which were identified as An. arabiensis and as being kdr-negative.
